title: Quick Algerian Lamb Tagine
description: A hearty and flavorful Algerian dish featuring lamb, English mustard, and a blend of spices, all cooked to perfection in a traditional cazuela vessel.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a large cazuela over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it starts to soften, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Stir in the English mustard, ground cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the cazuela, and simmer for 20 minutes.
Remove the lid and continue to simmer for an additional 10 minutes, or until the lamb is tender.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
